statement.excerpt: I also just did a piece about how OpenAI will kill Oracle.
statement.document_title: OpenAI Projects ChatGPT Plus subscriptions to drop by 80% from 44 Million in 2025 to 9 Million In 2026, Made Up Using Cheaper Subscriptions (Somehow)

our_interpretation: The assessed proposition is the embedded prediction about Oracle, not the statement that Zitron published another article.
I read kill as corporate failure: bankruptcy, liquidation, or permanent cessation of Oracle's business.
OpenAI's dealings with Oracle must be a principal cause of that failure. A share-price fall, layoffs, or financial pressure alone does not meet the threshold.
A voluntary acquisition alone would not establish corporate failure caused by OpenAI.
criteria.support_condition: A documented Oracle corporate failure occurs, with credible financial or legal records establishing its OpenAI dealings as a principal cause.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive event permanently closes the claimed causal pathway while Oracle survives, such as final resolution of all relevant OpenAI-related obligations and losses with no continuing exposure. Continued operation at an arbitrary evaluation date is insufficient.
